name: Standard Pipe Clamp with EPDM Lining
shortDescription: Two-piece clamp with sound insulation lining for standard mechanical installations.
description: High-grade electro-galvanized two-piece clamp engineered for pipe stabilization and acoustic dampening. Suitable for heating, sanitary, and acoustic insulation projects.

name: Heavy Duty Clevis Hanger
shortDescription: Adjustable clevis hanger for suspending stationary insulated or non-insulated pipelines.
description: Engineered clevis hanger fabricated from high-strength carbon steel. Provides vertical adjustment after installation to accommodate required piping gradients.

name: Pipe Roller Support Assembly
shortDescription: Pipe roller for lines subject to longitudinal movement due to thermal expansion.
description: Heavy-duty cast iron roller with steel axle and cradle designed to eliminate binding and absorb thermal expansion stresses in industrial piping.

specifications.value: Cast Iron Roller, Structural Steel Stand

name: Industrial U-Bolt Fastener
shortDescription: Classic U-bolt for guiding or anchoring pipes to structural profiles and steelwork.
description: Standard industrial U-bolt supplied complete with 4 nuts for rigid anchoring or guided pipe movement. Precision-rolled threads ensure maximum holding torque.

name: Plain Strut Channel 41x41
shortDescription: Standard 41x41 profile for heavy framing, cable management, and multi-service trapeze supports.
description: Cold roll-formed metal framing channel offering supreme bending resistance. Compatible with all standard spring channel nuts and modular bracket assemblies.

name: Slotted Strut Channel 41x21
shortDescription: Low-profile slotted back channel for space-constrained installations and quick alignment.
description: Precision punched continuous slotted back channel allows fast threaded rod insertion and on-site positioning without field welding or drilling.

name: Heavy Duty Cantilever Arm
shortDescription: Pre-welded wall bracket for side-mounting pipework, cable trays, and ducts directly to walls.
description: High load cantilever arm with heavy-gauge backplate and channel strut member welded with precision fillet weld. Designed for severe loading without deflection.

name: Channel Spring Nut and Bolt Set
shortDescription: Self-aligning zinc-plated spring nuts and high-tensile hardware for rapid channel connections.
description: Zinc-plated case-hardened spring nut with alternating grooves that grip into channel return lips, providing outstanding slip-resistance and vibration tolerance.

name: Rigid Fixing Point Assembly
shortDescription: Stable anchor clamp designed to withstand extreme axial pipe thermal thrust forces.
description: Engineered fixpoint clamp providing complete longitudinal locking for chilled water, hot water, and steam pipelines while maintaining thermal isolation.

name: Modular Expansion Device
shortDescription: Single and multi-tier sliding guide to safely accommodate long-run pipe expansion.
description: Low-friction sliding support block designed to allow unrestricted axial motion with zero binding under heavy pipe loads.

name: Heavy Duty Beam Clamps
shortDescription: Clamping attachment to structural I-beams and channels without drilling or field welding.
description: Drop-forged carbon steel beam clamp with cone-pointed set screw and locking nut. Meets high seismic and static load ratings.

name: Universal Structural Base Plates
shortDescription: Multi-hole base plate for anchoring vertical strut stanchions to concrete floors or walls.
description: Pre-punched 6mm thick base plate engineered for high moment load transfer from vertical support legs directly into concrete foundations.

name: Industrial Anti-Vibration Isolator
shortDescription: Spring and neoprene elastomeric mounts to isolate pipe vibration and reduce structure-borne noise.
description: High deflection spring mount designed for pumps, chillers, and suspended piping. Prevents mechanical vibration transmission into building structures.

name: Seismic Sway Brace Assembly
shortDescription: Rigid and cable seismic sway bracing systems to protect critical MEP piping during earthquakes.
description: Code-compliant seismic lateral and longitudinal brace fitting designed to restrain MEP distribution systems against seismic and wind forces.
